parsed.title: Abbacy Global Group — Study Abroad & Overseas Education Consultancy
parsed.description: Abbacy Global Group is Hyderabad's premier overseas education consultancy with 15+ years of operational excellence, an industry-leading 99.2% student visa success rate, and 10,000+ placed alumni across top global universities in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Germany, Ireland, France, Netherlands, and Dubai. Headquartered at Himayatnagar, Hyderabad, Abbacy provides 100% free personalized counseling, university shortlisting across 500+ global partner institutions, test preparation waivers (IELTS/PTE/GRE), collateral-free education loans up to ₹50 Lakhs, Telangana ePASS ₹20 Lakhs scholarship assistance, and daily 1-on-1 consular mock interviews.

links.title: Study in USA Guide
links.description: Complete guide to American universities, F-1 visa approvals, STEM OPT (up to 36 months work authorization), GRE waivers, Day-1 CPT policies, and average starting salaries ($85,000–$120,000/yr).

links.title: Study in UK Guide
links.description: Intensive 1-year Master's programs, Russell Group university admissions (Manchester, Birmingham, Leeds, UCL), 2-year post-study Graduate Route work visa, CAS issuance, and £2,000–£10,000 merit scholarships.

links.title: Study in Canada Guide
links.description: 2026/2027 IRCC rules, Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL) process, Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP up to 3 years), Co-op work programs, and Express Entry PR score building.

links.title: Study in Australia Guide
links.description: Group of Eight (Go8) university applications, Subclass 500 student visa, Subclass 485 Temporary Graduate work rights, regional migration incentives, and high minimum wage protections.

links.title: Study in Germany Guide
links.description: Tuition-free education (€0 tuition) at public universities (TU9), mandatory APS certificate verification, €11,904/year blocked account (Ausländerbehörde requirement), and 18-month Job Seeker Visa.

links.title: Study in Ireland Guide
links.description: Europe's English-speaking tech capital (Silicon Docks Dublin), 1-year Master's, 2-year Stamp 1G post-study work visa, and fast-track Critical Skills Employment Permits.

links.title: Study in France Guide
links.description: Subsidized tuition (€2,770–€3,770/yr) at public universities, Grande École business schools, CAF accommodation housing allowance (up to 40% rent rebate), and 5-year post-study Schengen circulation visa.

links.title: Study in Netherlands Guide
links.description: Over 2,100 English-taught programs, 1-year Zoekjaar (Orientation Year) work visa, high graduate employment in European tech hubs (Amsterdam, Eindhoven).

links.title: Study in Dubai Guide
links.description: International branch campuses (Heriot-Watt, Wollongong, Birmingham, Middlesex), 0% personal income tax, fast 15-day visa approval without IELTS, and direct GCC employment opportunities.

links.title: Scholarship Portal & Telangana ePASS Guide
links.description: Eligibility rules and documentation for Ambedkar Overseas Vidya Nidhi (SC/ST) and Mahatma Jyothiba Phule BC Overseas Scholarship (up to ₹20,00,000 grants plus one-way airfare), plus global institutional merit discounts.

links.title: Collateral-Free Education Loan Guide
links.description: Unsecured education loans up to ₹50–60 Lakhs, secured loans up to ₹1.5 Crore via SBI, HDFC Credila, Axis Bank, Avanse, and international non-collateral lenders (Prodigy Finance, MPOWER Financing).

mainEntity.name: Why choose Abbacy Global Group for studying abroad from Hyderabad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Abbacy Global Group is Hyderabad's most trusted overseas education consultancy with 15+ years of experience, a 99% visa success rate, and 10,000+ students placed across 11 countries. Located in Himayatnagar, we provide 100% free career counselling, 500+ university partnerships worldwide, 4.9/5 Google rating from verified students, and end-to-end support from test prep to campus arrival.

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to study abroad for Indian students?

acceptedAnswer.text: Annual tuition costs for Indian students vary by destination: USA (₹15–40 Lakhs/yr), UK (₹12–30 Lakhs/yr for 1-year Master's), Canada (₹10–25 Lakhs/yr), Australia (₹12–30 Lakhs/yr), Germany (€0 tuition at public universities), and Dubai (₹8–20 Lakhs/yr). Abbacy Global helps students secure scholarships and collateral-free education loans to minimize costs.

mainEntity.name: Does Abbacy provide IELTS coaching in Hyderabad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! Abbacy Global provides expert coaching for IELTS (Academic & General), TOEFL iBT, PTE Academic, Duolingo English Test, and GRE/GMAT. We offer experienced trainers, updated study materials, regular mock tests, and personalized score-improvement strategies at our Himayatnagar center.

mainEntity.name: Can I study abroad without IELTS from Hyderabad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! Several top universities in the UK, USA, Canada, Dubai, and Europe accept Indian students without IELTS through Medium of Instruction (MOI) letters from your college, Duolingo English Test scores, university internal English exams, or Class 12 English scores of 70%+. Contact Abbacy Global at +91 83097 13212 for personalised guidance.

mainEntity.name: Can I study in Dubai without IELTS from Hyderabad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! Leading international branch campuses in Dubai (Heriot-Watt, University of Birmingham, University of Wollongong Dubai, Middlesex) accept Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificates from Indian universities or 65%+ in Class 12 English. UAE student visas are university-sponsored with 99.8% approval and 0% personal income tax.

mainEntity.name: Why is Ireland popular for Hyderabad IT and engineering graduates?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ireland is Europe's only native English-speaking tech capital (Silicon Docks in Dublin) hosting Google, Meta, Microsoft, and Amazon. It offers high-ROI 1-year Master's programs with an automatic 2-year post-study work visa (Stamp 1G) and direct pathways to Critical Skills Employment Permits and Permanent Residency.

mainEntity.name: How can Hyderabad students get the Telangana ₹20 Lakh overseas scholarship?

acceptedAnswer.text: Eligible students from Telangana can apply for the Ambedkar Overseas Vidya Nidhi (SC/ST) or Mahatma Jyothiba Phule BC Overseas Scheme (BC/EBC) on the ePASS portal to receive up to ₹20,00,000 non-repayable grants plus one-way airfare. Abbacy Global provides free eligibility evaluation and documentation assistance in Himayatnagar.

mainEntity.name: How to study in Germany for free from Hyderabad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Germany offers tuition-free education at public universities (TU9) even for international students. Requirements include: strong academic marks (60-70%+), German or English proficiency, a blocked account with €11,904/year (€992/month) for living expenses, and mandatory APS certificate verification in New Delhi. Abbacy Global guides you through APS, admissions, and German student visa approval.

mainEntity.name: Which is the cheapest country to study abroad from India?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most affordable study abroad destinations include Germany (free tuition at public universities, living cost ~₹8-10 Lakhs/year), Dubai (AED 45k-75k with 0% tax jobs and fast visa), Poland (tuition from ₹2-5 Lakhs/year), and France (subsidized public fees €2,770–€3,770/yr with CAF housing subsidy). Abbacy Global helps you find the best value-for-money university matching your profile.

mainEntity.name: Why study abroad? What are the benefits?

acceptedAnswer.text: Studying abroad provides world-class education, access to global tech & engineering hubs, post-study work permits (3-year OPT in USA, 2-year Graduate Route in UK, 18 months in Germany, 1-year Zoekjaar in Netherlands), permanent residency pathways, and international salaries 3x to 5x higher than entry-level domestic packages.

mainEntity.name: What are the steps to study abroad from Hyderabad?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 6-step study abroad roadmap with Abbacy Global: 1) Free counselling & profile evaluation, 2) Test prep & waivers (IELTS/PTE/GRE), 3) University shortlisting & application filing, 4) Offer letter & scholarship negotiation, 5) Education loan & financial proof structuring, 6) Student visa filing & consular mock interview coaching.

mainEntity.name: How to get an education loan for studying abroad from Hyderabad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Abbacy Global helps students secure education loans up to ₹1 Crore+ with collateral, or up to ₹50–60 Lakhs collateral-free (unsecured) through trusted partner banks (SBI, HDFC Credila, Axis Bank, ICICI, Union Bank) and international lenders (Prodigy Finance, MPOWER). We handle eligibility assessment, documentation, and expedited sanction letters.

mainEntity.name: What documents are required to study abroad from India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Commonly required documents include: Academic transcripts & degree certificates (10th, 12th, B.Tech/Degree), English test scorecard or MOI certificate, Statement of Purpose (SOP), Letters of Recommendation (LORs), valid passport, financial proof (bank statements, ITR, loan sanction letter), and updated resume.

mainEntity.name: Which country is best for MBBS abroad from Hyderabad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Top countries for MBBS abroad for Indian students include Russia, Georgia, Philippines, and Uzbekistan. These destinations offer NMC-approved English-medium medical colleges with affordable fees (₹15–30 Lakhs total package) without donation or capitation fees. Abbacy Global provides direct admissions and visa guidance.

mainEntity.name: Best overseas education consultants near Ameerpet, Hyderabad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Abbacy Global Group, located at Himayatnagar, is just 10-15 minutes from Ameerpet via the Hyderabad Metro (Red Line/Blue Line). We are Hyderabad's #1 overseas education consultancy with 15+ years experience, 99% visa approval rate, and free walk-in counselling Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 7 PM. Call +91 83097 13212.

Requirements include: strong academic marks (60-70%+), German or English proficiency, a blocked account with €11,904/year (€992/month) for living expenses, and mandatory APS certificate verification in New Delhi. Abbacy Global guides you through APS, admissions, and German student visa approval.

mainEntity.name: Which is the cheapest country to study abroad from India?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most affordable study abroad destinations include Germany (free tuition at public universities, living cost ~₹8-10 Lakhs/year), Dubai (AED 45k-75k with 0% tax jobs and fast visa), Poland (tuition from ₹2-5 Lakhs/year), and France (subsidized public fees €2,770–€3,770/yr with CAF housing subsidy). Abbacy Global helps you find the best value-for-money university matching your profile.

mainEntity.name: Why study abroad? What are the benefits?

acceptedAnswer.text: Studying abroad provides world-class education, access to global tech & engineering hubs, post-study work permits (3-year OPT in USA, 2-year Graduate Route in UK, 18 months in Germany, 1-year Zoekjaar in Netherlands), permanent residency pathways, and international salaries 3x to 5x higher than entry-level domestic packages.

acceptedAnswer.text: The 6-step study abroad roadmap with Abbacy Global: 1) Free counselling & profile evaluation, 2) Test prep & waivers (IELTS/PTE/GRE), 3) University shortlisting & application filing, 4) Offer letter & scholarship negotiation, 5) Education loan & financial proof structuring, 6) Student visa filing & consular mock interview coaching.

mainEntity.name: What documents are required to study abroad from India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Commonly required documents include: Academic transcripts & degree certificates (10th, 12th, B.Tech/Degree), English test scorecard or MOI certificate, Statement of Purpose (SOP), Letters of Recommendation (LORs), valid passport, financial proof (bank statements, ITR, loan sanction letter), and updated resume.

mainEntity.name: Which country is best for MBBS abroad from Hyderabad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Top countries for MBBS abroad for Indian students include Russia, Georgia, Philippines, and Uzbekistan. These destinations offer NMC-approved English-medium medical colleges with affordable fees (₹15–30 Lakhs total package) without donation or capitation fees.
